trace.query: According to the January 2025 DKU Library Guide, which floor is the Tea House on?

retrieved_chunks.title: Dku Library Guide 202501
retrieved_chunks.text:
s use swipe access. The guide lists 23 self and group study rooms and 560 seats.

1st floor information desk in this brochure:
Monday-Thursday: 09:00-21:00
Friday: 09:00-17:30
Saturday: 14:00-18:00
Sunday: 14:00-20:00

The Tea House is on the 3rd floor and connects to a sky garden. The Meditation Room is on the 4th floor (LIB4-16) and looks over the Academic Quad.

retrieved_chunks.title: Dku Library Guide 202501
retrieved_chunks.text:
DKU Library Guide (January 2025 brochure)

This document copies service hours and space facts from the January 2025 DKU Library Guide PDF. Where it disagrees with the later Locations & Hours website, treat the website as current and this brochure as dated January 2025.

Library building: Monday-Sunday 08:00-23:00. Side gates use swipe access. The guide lists 23 self and group study rooms and 560 seats.

retrieved_chunks.title: Dku Library Guide 202501
retrieved_chunks.text:
Meditation Room is on the 4th floor (LIB4-16) and looks over the Academic Quad.

Source: https://library.dukekunshan.edu.cn/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Duke-Kunshan-University-Library-Guide-202501.pdf (January 2025 guide; retrieved 2026-09-10)

retrieved_chunks.title: Dku Library Handbook 2021
retrieved_chunks.text:
as historical text. It does not describe the current dedicated library building.

In this 2021 handbook, the DKU Library is described as occupying two rooms on the first and second floor of the Academic Building. The listed phone number is (0512) 3665-7027. The listed email is dkulibrary@dukekunshan.edu.cn. The handbook also mentions a joint service relationship with Duke University Libraries (DUL).
